程序包 org.bukkit.event.player

类 AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.player.AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent
public class AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent extends Event
Stores details for players attempting to log in. 存储尝试登录的玩家的详细信息。

This event is asynchronous, and not run using main thread. 该事件是异步的，不在主线程上运行。
